title: ARCH-3 B feasibility diagnostic: decision rule written BEFORE the diagnostic runs
status: ORACLE_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY (official labels; not an algorithm result)
width: canonical instance inscribed width (R4-B1T Gate 0), valid area D_gt
target_set: 3-6 px instances that FAIL B2 initial-region Oracle A (IoU < 0.5); expected 24 on training sheets

B1_within_instance.narrow_part: skeleton pixels whose local inscribed width (2*EDT-0.5 at the skeleton pixel) < 6 px
report: share of skeleton length that is narrow
of these, instances that fail B2 initial Oracle A

B2_cross_instance_tiers.T0_same_code_near: another instance of the same official unit (unit.npy majority), canonical width >= 6 px, minimum pixel distance <= 60 px
B2_cross_instance_tiers.T1_continuable: T0 AND endpoint gap <= 60 px AND |angle(axis_narrow, axis_wide_local)| <= 30 deg AND |angle(axis_narrow, gap vector)| <= 30 deg; axes by PCA of the narrow instance and of the wide instance pixels within 40 px of the gap point
B2_cross_instance_tiers.T2_geological_support: T1 AND Jaccard(neighbouring official units of the narrow instance, neighbouring units of the wide instance within 40 px of the gap point) >= 0.5 (same flanking units = same stratigraphic band)
B2_cross_instance_tiers.note: same code is not the same continuous layer; only T2 is treated as plausible continuity, T0/T1 as opportunity only

decision_rule.B_main_route_for_3_6_if: training-sheet T2 opportunity covers >= 0.30 of the target set (>= 8 of 24)
decision_rule.else: B becomes an auxiliary module (pinch-out geometry and local continuity); ARCH-3 main hypothesis = A + candidate pool + selective subdivision
decision_rule.exposed_sheets: reported as cross-check; they cannot change this rule or the decision

also_report: T0/T1/T2 counts for all 3-6 px instances and for the target set
the same for instances missed by the final RAG_BOUNDARY_ONLY (IoU < 0.5)
per sheet counts and Wilson 95% intervals
